result.reason: The operative language adds professional-and-workmanlike performance, material conformance, no-malicious-code protection, and repair/re-performance/replacement/refund remedies, but it omits the required compliance-with-laws warranty. It also does not implement the stated durations: software conformance applies “during the term,” rather than 12 months (or the 90-day fallback), and no 90-day or 30-day services warranty period is specified. This may materially exceed the required software duration and makes the margin comment’s claim of a 90-day warranty inaccurate. The carve-out generally preserves the unrelated disclaimer, but “if none is achieved” and the remedy sequencing are imprecise.
